Method of Attack: credential stuffing attack using configuration files to emulate login process and test credential lists for valid logins
Discoverer: Andy Norton, Director of Threat Intelligence for LastLine
Impacted Systems: Dunkin' Donuts DD Perks reward program accounts
Attack Vector: credential stuffing using leaked usernames and passwords from other breaches
Indicators of Compromise: Dunkin' Donuts DD Perks account login attempts detected by security vendor starting January 10, 2019
